entities.summary: Ribeirão Pires is a city in the Metropolitan Region of the city of São Paulo, in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. It is part of the "ABC Region” of Greater São Paulo. The population is 124,159 in an area of 99.1 km2. The elevation is 763 m.
